parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The description. Matched by fuzzy match
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The extension mode filter. Valid values:

NONE: custom entity only.
TABLE: extension table entity

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

Name: sorted by name.

The sort direction. Valid values:

Asc: ascending order.
